'''Howlerbeast Playground''' is an [[Facility/Ornamental|Ornamental]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.|Arcane likes small critters and easily zones out when she spots them. This critter playground is one of the very few things she has purchased for herself. She once spent three hours watching them play.}}

==Usage==
An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.
